Principality of Nitra and Nitra are the same land in two Cliopatria rows with different Wikidata ids; kept as two dossiers. If the orchestrator wants one state, merge under principality-of-nitra.
Duchy of Bohemia ends 1002 per Cliopatria but the state continues to 1198; kingdom-of-bohemia (eu-15, from 1202) or a gap-filler must cover 1003-1201.
Cliopatria's Principality of Hungary shape (900-910) excludes Nitra (until 911) and Transylvania; the Hungary dossiers (principality-of-hungary, kingdom-of-hungary) should take them from 907.
